findings.title: Pause and Delete disappear from Grafana rule list menus
findings.body: The new list item supplies only promRule to RuleActionsButtons, but AlertRuleMenu still requires a Grafana rulerRule to render Pause and requires rulerRule to render Delete. Computing the Prometheus-based abilities does not remove those rendering guards. Consequently, even users with update and delete permissions can no longer pause, resume, or delete Grafana-managed rules from the new list. These actions need handlers and rendering paths that work with the Prometheus rule identifier.

findings.title: Silence notifications is a no-op for Prometheus-only list items
findings.body: GrafanaRuleListItem now calls this component without rule, and AlertRuleMenu can display Silence notifications using promRule permissions. Clicking it sets showSilenceDrawer to true, but the drawer is still rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. With rule undefined that condition is always false, so no drawer opens. Load the required ruler data on demand or adapt the drawer to accept the Prometheus rule before exposing this action.

findings.title: The skip token still grants Grafana duplicate abilities
findings.body: Passing skipToken converts the rule to undefined but does not disable the returned abilities. For an undefined rule, useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities treats duplication as supported and allows it whenever the user has Grafana rule-create permission. AlertRuleMenu calls this hook with skipToken for data-source-managed rules and ORs its result with the ruler abilities. This can expose Duplicate for external rules whose ruler does not support it, or for plugin-provided external rules whose duplication was explicitly disabled. Return disabled abilities when the hook is skipped rather than evaluating an absent rule as a supported Grafana rule.

findings.title: Preserve the immutability check for federated rule groups
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously checked isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group), but it now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, where isFederated is hardcoded to false. Existing CombinedRule consumers therefore lose the protection that disables Update and Delete for Mimir federated groups with source_tenants. Users with external write permissions are now offered editing and deletion of rules that this UI previously treated as immutable. Preserve the group-level federation information when delegating rather than dropping this existing restriction.

findings.title: Grafana recording rules lose the Export menu action
findings.body: The Prometheus-based ModifyExport ability is supported only for alerting rules. The previous ruler-based ability used rulerRuleType.grafana.rule, which includes Grafana recording rules as well. Since the new Grafana list items no longer supply rulerRule, recording rules now have no supported export ability and their Export menu disappears even for users with read permission. Use the Grafana-rule check rather than the alerting-only check for this action to retain recording-rule export.
